context: Hello!(:
Howdy!!
how're ya doing?
Good, thanks for asking
thats good! im curious what was the last movie you saw?:)
I can't remember the last movie i saw in theaters but last week i binged all the sam raimi Spider-Man movies
thats dope! spider-man has to be my favorite hero from the MCU, so, movie wise, what did you like about it and do you want a story similar to that or different?

well i grew up on the raimi spider-man movies so they just hold a special spot in my heart, but the past few months ive been getting into some psychological kind of stuff. id say im looking for something along the lines of like Shutter Island, Donny Darko, Silence of the Lambs, doesnt have to be about murders... just something to make you think
Mmm, i see. Have you seen memento?
No i haven't but i've heard a lot about it... i looove Chris Nolan movies, that sounds like a perfect suggestion. i accept!
Awesome!
Alright i guess i click done now?
I believe so :)
actually, before i go... what kind of movies are you into?
mm to be honest im into psychological stuff too, but mostly movies based off of books, (or true stories in general) haha
ahh, have you seen Empire of the Sun?
No i havent, do you recommend it? also, i really enjoy tim burton's stuff!

I do and i don't at the same time, its Spielburg and like an 8 year old christian bale. i really liked it but its kinda tough to watch at some parts and gets a little cracked out and confusing towards the end. its about a little British boy getting taken from his parents and put in an internment camp soooooo, can be edgy
mm sounds like something middle school me would've been very into, haha. sounds interesting though, maybe ill have to check it out sometime.
well, im gonna go watch myself some 'Momento', it was nice chatting with ya! have a good one
